title: Anonymous bounded public Sesh project discovery service
purpose: Compose the SESH-054 bounded explicit-public publication read with canonical project and optional creator presentation checks before any discovery route or page exists.
resolutionContract: Read only bounded explicit-public publication records.
Fail closed if a returned publication is not public.
Load each canonical project by publication projectId.
Require canonical project id to equal publication projectId.
Require canonical project ownerCreatorId to equal publication ownerCreatorId.
Sanitize project output to id, title, and optional description.
Look up creator handle only by the verified canonical project owner.
A missing creator handle reservation does not hide an otherwise explicit-public project.
Require any returned reservation creatorId to equal the verified project owner.
Look up public creator profile only after a valid reservation exists.
A missing public creator profile does not hide an otherwise explicit-public project.
Require any returned profile id to equal the canonical reservation creatorId.
Sanitize creator output to handle and displayName only.
Any persistence/storage failure fails the complete discovery read closed as unavailable.
privacyBoundary: Private projects are never queried through a private-state discovery path.
No PrincipalId, account identity, session identity, CRM identity, or legal identity is emitted.
Missing creator public presentation is not an existence oracle for private project state.
rightsBoundary: Public presentation does not grant copyright, master, composition, publishing, distribution, label, management, royalty, licensing, revenue, collaborator, legal, CRM, account, or identity rights.
next: Expose the locked sanitized discovery service through a human /sesh/ discovery page or a separately justified anonymous HTTP boundary.
